Determine onboarding state based on vulnerability table existence and data population.

- notOnboarded: Table does not exist (requires ITAM/ITV onboarding).
- inProgress: Table exists but is empty (verify OneAgent & Beacon agent installations).
- onboarded: Table exists and has data (ready to display vulnerability results).

{

}
